title: nf-core/gwas pipeline parameters
description: A pipeline for Genome Wide Association Studies.

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

cohort_manifest.description: Path to the cohort manifest declaring cohort-owned genotype facts.
cohort_manifest.help_text: Supply together with `analysis_manifest`. Each unique `cohort_id` declares one complete PLINK 2, PLINK 1 or VCF genotype representation.

analysis_manifest.description: Path to the analysis manifest declaring cohort and trait analysis units.
analysis_manifest.help_text: Supply together with `cohort_manifest`. Each unique `analysis_id` references one declared `cohort_id`, names the trait and phenotype inputs, and selects association or heritability methods.

summary_statistics_manifest.description: Optional summary-statistics manifest declaring external or pipeline-generated results.
summary_statistics_manifest.help_text: Each unique `summary_statistics_id` declares exactly one external source or one producing analysis/method pair and owns any unary summary-statistics methods. Supply this manifest alone for external summary-only work or alongside the linked cohort and analysis manifests.

relationship_manifest.description: Optional relationship manifest declaring explicit pairwise endpoint requests.
relationship_manifest.help_text: Each relationship binds explicit left and right analysis and/or summary-statistics endpoints and selects one or more supported pairwise estimators. No pairs are inferred when this parameter is absent.

reference_catalog.description: Optional catalog of explicitly named LDSC and LDAK reference bundles.
reference_catalog.help_text: Summary-statistics requests select one family-specific bundle by `reference_bundle_id`. The pipeline validates required resource roles and path availability but does not infer a bundle from ancestry or certify scientific compatibility.

method_options.description: Optional structured scientific method options and stageable resources.
method_options.help_text: Legacy documents may remain keyed directly by `analysis_id`. Namespaced documents use `analyses`, `unary_requests` and `pair_requests`. GCTA pair requests accept `native_args`, and a relationship's deterministic bivariate LDMS request additionally accepts its matrix settings. Summary requests select references here; explicitly named additions declare a complete independent configuration beneath the selected deterministic primary request. Operational partitioning and task sizing belong to run/profile configuration.

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved. You have to use absolute paths to storage on Cloud infrastructure.

email.help_text: Set this parameter to your e-mail address to get a summary e-mail with details of the run sent to you when the workflow exits. If set in your user config file (`~/.nextflow/config`) then you don't need to specify this on the command line for every run.

multiqc_title.description: MultiQC report title. Printed as page header, used for filename if not otherwise specified.

save_controls.title: Save controls
save_controls.description: Publish intermediates that are otherwise kept out of the results directory.
save_controls.help_text: Intermediates are unpublished by default so that a large run does not fill your storage with files you did not ask for. Each save control turns one family of intermediates back on.

save_prepared_genotypes.description: Save the canonical PLINK 2 genotype bundle prepared for each cohort.
save_prepared_genotypes.help_text: Prepared bundles are published to `<outdir>/genotypes/<cohort_id>/` so that you can inspect them or reuse them outside the pipeline. Only bundles the pipeline built are saved: a cohort supplied as PLINK 2 `pgen`/`psam`/`pvar` is already canonical and is used exactly as given, so there is nothing to save for it.

save_normalised_phenotypes.description: Save the normalised phenotype and covariate files prepared for each analysis unit.
save_normalised_phenotypes.help_text: Normalised files are published to `<outdir>/phenotypes/<analysis_id>/` so that you can check how your trait was recoded before an association or heritability run consumed it. The set is the headered phenotype file, the separate quantitative and categorical covariate files, and the merged covariate file; the headerless serialisations and the normalisation log are never published.

save_relatedness_matrices.description: Save reusable GCTA and LDAK relatedness-matrix bundles built for heritability and mixed-model routes.
save_relatedness_matrices.help_text: Matrices are published to `<outdir>/quality_control/relatedness_matrices/<key>/`, where `<key>` is the content-derived reuse key of the matrix: a digest over the cohort identity and every construction setting that changes the matrix. The path is key-addressed rather than cohort-addressed because one cohort can carry several distinct matrices, and because a matrix that several analyses share belongs to none of them. Only the merged bundle is saved; the per-partition files it was built from are not.

save_association_predictions.description: Save reusable REGENIE and LDAK-KVIK Step 1 prediction bundles.
save_association_predictions.help_text: Prediction bundles are absent from published output by default. Enable this control to publish analysis-attributed bundles under `<outdir>/intermediates/association_predictions/<method>/<analysis_id>/`.

gcta_run_options.title: GCTA run configuration
gcta_run_options.description: Configure operational GCTA task partitioning independently of scientific analysis metadata.

gcta_grm_parts.description: Number of operational partitions used to construct each GCTA relatedness matrix.

regenie_options.title: REGENIE run configuration
regenie_options.description: Configure operational REGENIE execution independently of per-analysis scientific method options.

regenie_step2_bsize.description: Number of variants in each REGENIE Step 2 block.

regenie_step1_mode.description: Run Step 1 in one task or through REGENIE's split-L0/run-L0/run-L1 execution family.

regenie_step1_jobs.description: Requested maximum number of L0 jobs for chunked Step 1. Required only when `regenie_step1_mode` is `chunked`.

regenie_lowmem.description: Use REGENIE's low-memory Step 1 implementation, keeping temporary predictions in the task work directory.

harmonisation_options.title: Harmonisation options
harmonisation_options.description: Optional reference resources used when standardising summary statistics with GWASLab.
harmonisation_options.help_text: Every association result is standardised by GWASLab whether or not these are supplied. Supplying them additionally allows GWASLab to check and flip alleles against the reference sequence, assign rsIDs, and infer the strand of palindromic variants. They are selected by the genome build declared for the analysis cohort, so a run mixing builds configures each build independently and an analysis on a build with no configured resource is standardised without one. Indexes are resolved automatically as `.fai`, `.tbi` or `.csi` sidecars.

gwaslab_reference_fasta_grch37.description: Reference sequence FASTA for GRCh37 analyses.

gwaslab_reference_fasta_grch38.description: Reference sequence FASTA for GRCh38 analyses.

gwaslab_rsid_vcf_grch37.description: Indexed VCF or BCF used to assign rsIDs to GRCh37 analyses.

gwaslab_rsid_vcf_grch38.description: Indexed VCF or BCF used to assign rsIDs to GRCh38 analyses.

gwaslab_strand_vcf_grch37.description: Indexed VCF or BCF used to infer the strand of palindromic variants in GRCh37 analyses.

gwaslab_strand_vcf_grch38.description: Indexed VCF or BCF used to infer the strand of palindromic variants in GRCh38 analyses.

institutional_config_options.title: Institutional config options
institutional_config_options.description: Parameters used to describe centralised config profiles. These should not be edited.
institutional_config_options.help_text: The centralised nf-core configuration profiles use a handful of pipeline parameters to describe themselves. This information is then printed to the Nextflow log when you run a pipeline. You should not need to change these values when you run a pipeline.

custom_config_version.description: Git commit id for Institutional configs.

custom_config_base.help_text: If you're running offline, Nextflow will not be able to fetch the institutional config files from the internet. If you don't need them, then this is not a problem. If you do need them, you should download the files from the repo and tell Nextflow where to find them with this parameter.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline, typically set in a config file.
generic_options.help_text:
These options are common to all nf-core pipelines and allow you to customise some of the core preferences for how the pipeline runs.

Typically these options would be set in a Nextflow config file loaded for all pipeline runs, such as `~/.nextflow/config`.

publish_dir_mode.description: Method used to save pipeline results to output directory.
publish_dir_mode.help_text: The Nextflow `publishDir` option specifies which intermediate files should be saved to the output directory. This option tells the pipeline what method should be used to move these files. See [Nextflow docs](https://www.nextflow.io/docs/latest/process.html#publishdir) for details.

email_on_fail.description: Email address for completion summary, only when pipeline fails.
email_on_fail.help_text: An email address to send a summary email to when the pipeline is completed - ONLY sent if the pipeline does not exit successfully.

plaintext_email.description: Send plain-text email instead of HTML.

max_multiqc_email_size.description: File size limit when attaching MultiQC reports to summary emails.

monochrome_logs.description: Do not use coloured log outputs.

multiqc_config.description: Custom config file to supply to MultiQC.

multiqc_logo.description: Custom logo file to supply to MultiQC. File name must also be set in the MultiQC config file.

multiqc_methods_description.description: Custom MultiQC yaml file containing HTML including a methods description.

validate_params.description: Boolean whether to validate parameters against the schema at runtime.

pipelines_testdata_base_path.description: Base URL or local path to location of pipeline test dataset files.

trace_report_suffix.description: Suffix to add to the trace report filename. Default is the date and time in the format yyyy-MM-dd_HH-mm-ss.

help_full.description: Display the full detailed help message.

show_hidden.description: Display hidden parameters in the help message (only works when --help or --help_full are provided).
